name: Progress MS-23
about: Progress MS-23 (2023-071A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MS), launched 2023 May 24. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2023 May 24), held fixed
